findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：關稅使毛利增加約 $1,000 千美元的額外成本（相對 FY2025）；毛利率 23.5%，下滑主因為產品組合（國防比重較高）。
findings.excerpt: The impact of increased tariffs for fiscal 2026 was approximately an incremental $1,000 compared to fiscal 2025.

findings.claim: 公司稱訂單到手才下原料採購以鎖價，且大部分國際銷售在當地製造，以隔離關稅影響。
findings.excerpt: we place orders for raw materials when the purchase orders are received from the customer to lock-in raw material pricing and manufacture a large portion of our international sales in-country which helps isolate us from the impacts of tariffs.

findings.claim: 風險因子：關稅可能影響電子元件、高階鋼材等原料成本，並使產品對海外客戶較不具吸引力。
findings.excerpt: Tariffs affecting our products and product components, including raw materials we use, particularly electronic components, high-end steel and steel related products, may add significant costs to us and make our products more expensive.

findings.claim: 受 ITAR、EAR、OFAC 規範；FY2026 15% 營收來自美國以外客戶，在中國與印度設有銷售與工程支援辦公室。
findings.excerpt: For fiscal 2026, 15% of our revenue was from customers located outside of the U.S. Moreover, through our subsidiaries, we maintain sales and engineering support offices in China and India.

note: 搜尋未找到 GHM 明確指稱 Section 232 的來源；Q3 FY2026 法說稱全年關稅增量預估 $1.0–1.5 百萬（僅摘要，未取逐字原文）。
